agree.reason: The plain apology and concrete changes speak to this household's grievance about the farm going quiet, but with no make-good for last year's loss and only a promise to communicate, a resistant reader may still hold back.

honest.reason: Every fact matches the brief and the derived 'three weeks' worth' is accurate; only 'no longer growing everything in one spot' is a small inference.

works_the_facts.reason: It turns six half-weeks into three lost weeks and puts the $31,000 next to the unchanged price, but it doesn't put a dollar value on the loss (about $74).

right_comparison.reason: It compares this year with last through the unchanged price and the new protections, but never shows the reader what not signing up would mean or how the risk has actually changed.

qualification.reason: The 'no farm is safe' hedge is honest and the March 15 and 52-share limits can be checked, but the promise to tell members 'straight away and in full' has no timeframe and no named remedy.

objections.reason: It meets the 'farm went quiet' objection head-on with an apology and a promise, but leaves open what members get if hail hits crops outside the nets, which the pause credit doesn't cover.

fit.reason: It's a personal email of about 190 words with a subject line, a clear call to action and placeholders, as the brief asked.
